statement: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab0d6714.scaled7ecfaf (row_id STRING NOT NULL, split STRING, f1 DOUBLE, f2 DOUBLE, f3 DOUBLE, f4 DOUBLE, CONSTRAINT scaled7ecfaf_pk PRIMARY KEY (row_id)) USING DELTA TBLPROPERTIES ('feature_store_version' = '1') AS WITH train_raw AS (SELECT row_id, CAST(f1 AS DOUBLE) AS f1, CAST(f2 AS DOUBLE) AS f2, CAST(f3 AS DOUBLE) AS f3, CAST(f4 AS DOUBLE) AS f4 FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab0d6714/data_upload/features_train.csv', format => 'csv', header => true, inferSchema => true)), serve_raw AS (SELECT row_id, CAST(f1 AS DOUBLE) AS f1, CAST(f2 AS DOUBLE) AS f2, CAST(f3 AS DOUBLE) AS f3, CAST(f4 AS DOUBLE) AS f4 FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab0d6714/data_upload/features_serve.csv', format => 'csv', header => true, inferSchema => true)), train_stats AS (SELECT AVG(f1) AS mean_f1, STDDEV_POP(f1) AS std_f1, AVG(f2) AS mean_f2, STDDEV_POP(f2) AS std_f2, AVG(f3) AS mean_f3, STDDEV_POP(f3) AS std_f3, AVG(f4) AS mean_f4, STDDEV_POP(f4) AS std_f4 FROM train_raw), all_raw AS (SELECT row_id, f1, f2, f3, f4, 'train' AS split FROM train_raw UNION ALL SELECT row_id, f1, f2, f3, f4, 'serve' AS split FROM serve_raw) SELECT a.row_id, a.split, ROUND((a.f1 - s.mean_f1) / s.std_f1, 6) AS f1, ROUND((a.f2 - s.mean_f2) / s.std_f2, 6) AS f2, ROUND((a.f3 - s.mean_f3) / s.std_f3, 6) AS f3, ROUND((a.f4 - s.mean_f4) / s.std_f4, 6) AS f4 FROM all_raw a CROSS JOIN train_stats s
